newsitem.title: UK: Gen. Accident up after record first quarter.
newsitem.headline: Gen. Accident up after record first quarter.

text.p: Shares in composite insurer General Accident Plc were indicated modestly higher on Tuesday after the company more than doubled operating profits to 114 million stg in the first quarter.
The shares were up 5-1/2p to 968-1/2p by 0711 GMT in pre-market trade.

"The operating profit was at the top end of expectations and the underwriting and weather related side was particularly good for them," said one senior trader. "But investment income was slightly sluggish."
The company said its worldwide underwriting result improved by 50 million stg, including a reduction in severe weather costs of 30 million stg.
Investment earnings during the quarter showed growth of two percent in original currencies.
Traders said gains could be limited after the recent strong gains in the share price leading up to the results.
"These results are certainly not disappointing but they are not brilliant either...the shares will be better initially but then we need to see some buyers coming in," one said.
Shares in General Accident have outperformed the rest of the sector by 11 percent, and the FTSE-All Share index by 16 percent since the beginning of this year.
